term: total finite-history binary prediction under truthful feedback
definition: Predictor is List Bool → Bool, deterministic and total, with newest-first finite histories. past truth n contains exactly labels before n; forecast p truth n is p on that past. history recursively prepends the opposite of p on its current history; diagonal p is the resulting one stream. historyWeights reconstructs the existing weighted update and weighted reuses the existing predict; advice experts truth evaluates each history-based expert on the same actual past. There is no random seed, chance model, computability restriction, semantic-content assignment or normative predicate.
